items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy is there taking care of the job, you know.

ctx.x: No, he didn't go to Tijuana with us. Dizzy is there taking care of the job, you know. Charlie Parker was very unpredictable during those days; well, most of the time he was unpredictable, you know. Because his values were far different from most people's values. Material things, things like that didn't mean anything to him. It looked like he would try to get rid of money fast as he could, you know. He'd get paid tonight, tomorrow is all gone, you know. That's the way he lived. Somebody would always take care of…
